sentences.text: Generated by NNC Pipeline (nnc adapt) from the port declarations of uart and from its netlist (which inputs clock or reset flops).
Do not edit by hand: nnc adapt rewrites it.
This document gives only the ports of the design under verification uart and which part of which port of uart each one carries.
The behaviour of uart is specified only by c_uart_Design_Specification.md; nothing here adds to it.
